question: A bakery sells muffins for $3 each and cookies for $2 each. Ana buys 7 muffins and 11 cookies. How many dollars does she spend? Give the final answer as a number.
A train travels at 84 km per hour for 2.5 hours, then at 60 km per hour for 1.5 hours. How many kilometers does it travel in total? Give the final answer as a number.
A 1,200 liter tank is 35% full. Then 180 liters are added. What percentage of the tank is full now? Give the final answer as a number.
Sam buys 3 notebooks at $4.75 each and pays with a $20 bill. How many dollars of change does he get? Give the final answer as a number.
A class has 28 students and the ratio of girls to boys is 4:3. How many boys are in the class? Give the final answer as a number.
A jacket costs $80. It is discounted by 25%, and then 10% sales tax is added to the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars? Give the final answer as a number.
6 workers can finish a job in 10 days. Working at the same rate, how many days would 4 workers need? Give the final answer as a number.
What is the sum of all integers from 1 to 150 inclusive? Give the final answer as a number.
A rectangle has a perimeter of 46 cm and a length of 15 cm. What is its area in square centimeters? Give the final answer as a number.
Mia has $140 saved and saves $35 more every week. After how many weeks will she have exactly $700? Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 5 miles to kilometers, using 1 mile = 1.609344 km. Round to 3 decimal places. Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 72 degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius. Round to 1 decimal place. Give the final answer as a number.
How many seconds are in 3.5 hours? Give the final answer as a number.
How many grams are in 2.5 kilograms? Give the final answer as a number.
How many mebibytes (MiB) are in 3 gibibytes (GiB)? Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 250 milliliters to liters. Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 100 km/h to meters per second. Round to 2 decimal places. Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 6 feet to centimeters, using 1 foot = 30.48 cm. Give the final answer as a number.
Convert 45 degrees to radians. Round to 4 decimal places. Give the final answer as a number.
One nautical mile is exactly 1852 meters. How many kilometers are 12 nautical miles? Give the final answer as a number.
What day of the week was 2024-02-29? Answer with the English weekday name.
How many days are there from 2023-12-25 to 2024-03-01 (the difference between the two dates)? Give the final answer as a number.
What date is 90 days after 2025-01-15? Answer with the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Is the year 2100 a leap year in the Gregorian calendar? Answer yes or no.
How many days does February 2028 have? Give the final answer as a number.
A meeting happens every 14 days. The first meeting is on 2026-01-05. On what date is the 5th meeting? Answer with the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
What date is exactly 3 weeks before 2026-03-10? Answer with the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
What is the ISO 8601 week number of 2026-01-01? Give the final answer as a number.
What day of the week was 2000-01-01? Answer with the English weekday name.
Someone was born on 1990-07-20. How old are they, in whole years, on 2026-07-19? Give the final answer as a number.
All bloops are razzies and all razzies are lazzies. Are all bloops definitely lazzies? Answer yes or no.
Alice is taller than Bob. Bob is taller than Carol. Who is the shortest? Answer with the name.
If it rains, the ground gets wet. The ground is not wet. Did it rain? Answer yes or no.
Five people stand in a line. E is first and D is last. A is somewhere before B, and C stands directly after B. Write the order from first to last as five letters with no spaces or separators.
A red, a blue and a green ball are placed one per box in boxes 1, 2 and 3. The red ball is not in box 1 and the blue ball is in box 3. Which box holds the green ball? Answer with the box number.
On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says: 'We are both knaves', speaking about himself and B. Is A a knight or a knave? Answer with one word.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ...? Give the final answer as a number.
How many integers from 1 to 100 inclusive are divisible by 3 or by 5? Give the final answer as a number.
Some cats are black. Everything black absorbs heat. Must at least one cat absorb heat? Answer yes or no.
An analog clock shows exactly 3:15. What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands, in degrees? Give the final answer as a number.

A conference charges $45 per attendee for the first 50 registrants and $38 per attendee for each registrant after the 50th. A company registers 72 attendees, in order. Afterward, the 5 most recently registered attendees cancel and are each fully refunded at the rate they were originally charged. How many dollars does the company end up paying, after the refunds? Give the final answer as a number.

A warehouse packs pens into boxes of 24 and staples into boxes of 36. An order calls for exactly 900 pens and 900 staples, and the warehouse ships in full boxes, never partial boxes, rounding each item up to the next full box as needed. How many total boxes, pens plus staples combined, does the warehouse ship? Give the final answer as a number.

A server rack draws 3.6 kilowatts continuously. Electricity costs $0.14 per kilowatt-hour, and the data center separately charges a flat $50 monthly cooling fee that is unrelated to power draw. Over a 30-day month, how many dollars does the electricity alone (excluding the cooling fee) cost? Give the final answer as a number.

A cloud provider measures storage in binary gibibytes (GiB, where 1 GiB = 2^30 bytes) but invoices customers in decimal gigabytes (GB, where 1 GB = 10^9 bytes). A workload stores 500 GiB, and a separate one-time snapshot fee of $10 applies regardless of size and is unrelated to this conversion. How many GB is 500 GiB? Round to 2 decimal places. Give the final answer as a number.

A monitoring job is scheduled to fire every 24 hours of elapsed real (UTC) time, starting at 2026-03-07 02:30 local time in America/Los_Angeles (UTC-8, standard time). Daylight Saving Time begins in America/Los_Angeles on 2026-03-08 at 02:00 local time, when clocks spring forward one hour to 03:00 (local time becomes UTC-7 from that instant on). Because the job advances by a fixed 24 hours of real elapsed time rather than 24 local wall-clock hours, what local time does its 2nd run (the one after 2026-03-07 02:30) occur at? Answer with the time in HH:MM format.

Using the convention that adding one month to a date keeps the same day-of-month unless that day does not exist in the target month, in which case the date rolls back to the target month's last day: starting from 2026-01-31, add one month three times in a row, where each step applies the rule to the RESULT of the previous step, not to the original date. What date results after the third step? Answer with the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Using the ISO 8601 rule that a week's number belongs to whichever calendar year contains that week's Thursday, and that a year has 53 ISO weeks exactly when 1 January falls on a Thursday, or on a Wednesday in a leap year: what is the ISO 8601 week number of 2026-12-31? Give the final answer as a number.

A courier charges a base fee of $6 plus $0.85 per kilometer for the first 10 kilometers, and $0.55 per kilometer for every kilometer beyond 10. A customer's delivery is 26 kilometers, and the customer has a $4 discount coupon that applies when the trip is over 20 kilometers, applied after all distance charges are added. How many dollars does the customer pay? Give the final answer as a number.

A factory produces 150 units per hour when running normally, but every 4th hour (hour 4, hour 8, and so on) it runs at half speed for maintenance instead. Production starts at hour 1 and runs continuously. After exactly 10 hours of production, how many total units have been produced? Give the final answer as a number.

On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. Three people, A, B and C, each make one statement. A says: 'B is a knave.' B says: 'C and I are the same type, both knights or both knaves.' C says: 'A and I are different types.' Exactly one assignment of knight or knave to each person is consistent with all three statements. Is A a knight or a knave? Answer with one word.
